snippet.title: Chris's Classroom V1.1 - New features!
snippet.description:
Chris's Classroom is my next upcoming game in the "Chris" games. This game is HEAVILY inspired by Baldi's Basics!

↓ ↓ ↓ Update V1.1 Log ↓ ↓ ↓
- Removed excess stress toys
- Updated UI for stress toy collection
- Adjusted hitboxes for collectibles
- Added new items: Coffee[1], Box of Cookies[2], Chris's Least Favourite Song[3]
- Map expansions
- Fixed Coffee item
- New structures: Television[4] and Sweet Treats Dispenser[5]
- Overhauled Thomas's AI

[1] Coffee replaces BSODA
[2] Box of Cookies replaces Energy Flavoured Zesty Bar
[3] Chris's Least Favourite Song replaces Baldi's Least Favourite Tape
[4] Television replaces Tape Player
[5] Sweet Treats Dispenser replaces the Zesty Bar vending machine


Engine used: Unity 2022.3.62f1
Almost all assets shown in game are created by me!
